notes.title: Upcoming updates for my games – overview post
notes.content:
Hello,

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35149563/1f27b730eff5ca3cba12ab760456f0ba03945bef.jpg[/img]

I wanted to share some info about current and upcoming updates. This is a summary post – just find the game you’re interested in. I’m working on all of these titles solo, without a publisher or PR support, so communication isn’t perfect and updates can take time (I also have a full-time job, and game development is still a hobby for now). Always check the demo before buying. Right now, the only game without a demo is Moving Letters (it’s not finished yet). If a game doesn’t work or has issues, don’t hesitate to use Steam’s refund option. If there is no information about the game, it means it is not released and is still being worked on.

[h1]Game-by-game update list:[/h1]
[u][b]HorrorCore[/b][/u]
Minor fixes. A sequel is planned where you play a detective investigating a mysterious painting.

[u][b]Airhack[/b][/u]
???

[u][b]Rap Simulator[/b][/u]
More info: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1099510/view/536604072953776663

[u][b]The Liminal Dimension[/b][/u]
Performance improvements. Continuation is planned (hinted at in the post-credits scene).

[u][b]Whispering Lane[/b][/u]
Fixes to the Last Hope mode. Continuation also planned (post-credits intro).

[u][b]Another Hardest Game[/b][/u]
Minor bug fixes.

[u][b]Apartament 1406[/b][/u]
Bug fixes, Improvements to Last Hope mode. The story is planned to continue in a two-part structure.

[u][b]Resoraki[/b][/u]
Fixes, a new night track, and some community suggestions added.
Multiplayer is under consideration – either as an update or as Resoraki 2.

[u][b]OutWave[/b][/u]
Minor fixes and implementation of player feedback.

[u][b]CATAIRE[/b][/u]
No CATAIRE 2 planned, but a big update is coming: UNDO and RESET buttons, HD visuals, and online scoreboards.

[b][u]A Last Will and Testament[/u][/b]
Minor fixes. Possible continuation.

[u][b]Hovercars 3077[/b][/u]
New tracks, cars, online rankings, and UI improvements (incl. ultrawide 21:9 support).

[u][b]MUMBA IV[/b][/u]
Already received a recent update. Possible continuation (next adventure trip).

[u][b]Shop Tycoon: Prepare Your wallet[/b][/u]
I'm currently working on Shop Tycoon 2: Revenge of the Bandytko Gang.
Once that’s finished, I might port Shop Tycoon 1 to the new engine with HD visuals (I’ll ask for community feedback first).

[u][b]ASMR LIGHTness[/b][/u]
Minor fixes and HD update.

[u][b]Bro, Where Is My Head???[/b][/u]
Minor fixes, maybe online rankings.
Also in the works: a long-awaited sequel – Bro, That’s Not My Head!

[b][u]Moving Letters[/u][/b]
Already updated (server issues fixed). Demo will be added later. Possible HD updated or continuation.

[u][b]THE IMPOSSIBLE[/b][/u]
Free DLC is planned, maybe a HD update and a sequel: THE IMPOSSIBLE 2: New Pat(c)h

[b][u]Play With Me[/u][/b]
I’m moving PWM 1 (Remake) to the engine for PWM 2. After that, Play With Me 2 will be released – and possibly future entries (Play With M3, Play With Me 4, etc.).

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - Please read
notes.content:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44072779/8653707f2d536e6c0a5d63d2f8852b660a974ecc.gif[/img]

A new version is available (v1.1.1). The most important change is the difficulty level, the default is EASY, it is more like exploration mode, combat is simple. You can change the game level in the menu at any time (EASY -> MEDIUM -> NIGHTMARE). 

- Added version to the main menu.
- Added "Difficulty Level" option. Default gameplay is set to EASY, even if loading a save game from before the update. The player can change the difficulty level at any point during the game.
[olist]
[*] EASY - If someone prefers to explore more than fight, this mode is ideal. Enemies are weak (axe 2-3 hits + increased range, pistol 2 shots, shotgun 1 shot - if fired up close), drop items more frequently). Player moves and runs faster, even when injured, the bosses are easy to defeat.
[*] MEDIUM - Slightly more challenging, there might be fewer items, fights aren't hard, but they're not easy either. The Player moves slightly faster normally and when injured.
[*] NIGHTMARE - Unchanged, few items are available, survival is near impossible (unless you played Quake 2 in 1999), real boss fight.[/olist]
- Added "Show always HP" option (health will always be visible).
- Enemies now drop items more frequently (except for Nightmare mode).
- Localization improvements for all languages (95). E.g., game-saving messages ("Saving...") etc.
- Graphic improvements (textures, some 3D models).
- Performance optimizations.
- Fixes to prevent players from getting stuck in certain areas.
- Gamepad adjustments.
- Fixes for certain options.
- AI and enemy adjustments.
- Fixes for bosses (hanging torture cage, bug with doors).
- Music fixes (boss etc.).
- Minor tweaks to the intro.
- Fixes for certain in-game objects
- Voice-over fixes for various languages (Polish, English, French, Chinese, etc.).
- Lighting/lamp fixes in certain places, e.g., room with wind blowing.
- Blood is more visible.
- Removed unnecessary code (debug, etc.).
- Other minor fixes.
- Update for Windows 32 and 64 bits, Linux 64 bits, and Mac 64 bits.

Thanks for your feedback, suggestions, etc.
